verdict.rationale: Rollbar claims broad platform coverage ('over a dozen platforms') and has an Apple Unified Logging integration module, hinting at some mobile/OS-level telemetry support, but the evidence pack contains no explicit documentation of iOS, Android, or NDK crash-reporting SDKs, nor confirmation that device, OS, and app-version context is captured for native mobile crashes. Missing for 10: dedicated iOS SDK docs, Android/NDK crash SDK docs, explicit device/OS/app-version metadata capture for native mobile crashes, and any hands-on/community confirmation of mobile crash reproduction.
